title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows and simplify Node matrix
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: Over the last 18 months our CI workflow surface grew organically (separate lint/test/release files, duplicate matrices, and divergent cache keys). This change consolidates the primary repo-level workflows into a smaller set with clear responsibilities, reduces duplicated runner matrix entries (Node 18/20 -> Node 20 LTS default with opt-in Node 18 for legacy packages), and simplifies cache keys to reduce flaky cache misses. Motivation: reduce CI maintenance overhead, improve cache hit rate, speed up PR feedback loop, and simplify release automation hygiene. What I changed: - Consolidated .github/workflows/lint.yml, test.yml, and release.yml into two workflows: .github/workflows/ci.yml (lint + test + build matrix) and .github/workflows/release.yml (release automation + tag/release notes generation). - Normalized Node matrix to default to Node 20 for most packages; legacy/compat packages opt into NODE_VERSION=18 via package metadata. - Standardized cache keys across actions to include repo, package path, node-version, and package-lock checksum to reduce collisions. - Centralized shared CI helper scripts into scripts/ci/*.sh and added idempotent retry logic for transient network failures. - Removed several duplicated workflow dispatch and schedule entries and migrated release automation to use the new release tool action (redwood/actions/release@v2). Backwards compatibility: opt-in Node 18 support implemented via package.json "ciSupport": ["node18"] field for legacy packages; existing packages keep current behavior. Checklist: - [x] Consolidated workflows and validated with dry-run on a staging branch - [x] Ran full monorepo test matrix locally and on ci/staging - [x] Verified release automation triggers and draft release generation - [x] Updated README/CONTRIBUTING CI sections - [x] Added guards and retries for flaky network steps Testing: Full CI run on branch (green) and one canary merge to release branch in staging. Linear/Jira: Linked ENG-2021, ENG-1987; SUP-345 for a support-related flaky-cache incident. Rollout: Merge to main, monitor CI flakiness metrics, revert path included. Notes: This is a hygiene/refactor PR focused on developer velocity; no runtime code changes. For repository consumers using self-hosted runners please ensure Actions runner images include Node 20; fallback to Node 18 remains available.
